title: Web Application Developer
description:
Datum Hub is an AI-native ERP, connecting procurement, inventory, projects, manufacturing, sales, accounting, and finance into a single operational source of truth, using grounded, permission-aware AI to support better decisions and actions. Designed for make-to-order manufacturers, project-led operators, and supply-chain businesses, Datum Hub tracks key operational data and integrates two-way with QuickBooks Online and Xero to keep operations aligned with financial records. The platform is engineered for trust with database-level company isolation, role-based access control, and immutable audit history. Datum Hub’s security program is built toward SOC 2 readiness, offering a robust and compliant environment for customers and team members.

**Role Description:**

The Web Application Developer will design, develop, and maintain web applications that power the Datum Hub operations platform. Day-to-day tasks include implementing back-end services and APIs, optimizing application performance, integrating with third-party systems such as accounting platforms, and ensuring data integrity and access control across the application. The role involves writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, participating in code reviews, and contributing to architectural decisions. The developer will also troubleshoot issues, perform debugging and testing, and help improve development processes and tooling.

You should have

* 3+ years building production web applications
* Strong database fundamentals
* Experience integrating external APIs
* Attention to detail, especially where numbers and data accuracy matter

You'll stand out if you have

* Experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing is a plus.

**About The Role**
We are looking for a Technical Architect who can own the technical architecture across two of Anchanto's most critical products OXM (Order Experience Management) and OMS (Order Management System). This is a senior individual contributor role with deep ownership of system design, scalability, reliability, and AI-powered capability delivery. You will be the technical authority across both platforms, ensuring architectural coherence, engineering standards, and a clear path to scale as Anchanto grows globally. This is not a hands-off advisory role. You will be deeply involved in design decisions, code reviews, incident resolution, and driving the engineering teams toward better patterns, faster delivery, and higher quality with AI as a force multiplier across the SDLC.
  
  
Anchanto is a global B2B SaaS company powering commerce for brands, retailers, logistics companies and enterprises. Our customers rely on it to realize 100% of their revenue on a daily basis. The platform is used by 300+ customers brands, retailers, and logistics providers, processes 150M+ orders annually, and serves thousands of users across operations teams in 12 countries including France, UK, Singapore, Malaysia and UAE.
  
  
**What Will Your Day Look Like?**

* Own architecture across OXM and OMS - lead system design for new capabilities, define integration patterns, and ensure both platforms evolve coherently as business requirements change.
* Design and evolve event-driven, distributed systems - ensure scalability, fault tolerance, multi-tenant isolation, and idempotency across AWS (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis).
* Lead AI capability architecture - design the technical foundation for AI-powered features inside OXM and OMS intelligent order routing, anomaly detection, demand forecasting, agentic workflows and ensure they meet enterprise-grade reliability, security, and cost standards.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Tech Leads - translate product requirements into technical blueprints, unblock design bottlenecks, and ensure engineering teams have clear architectural guidance before execution begins.
* Own cross-platform integration standards - define API versioning, contract testing, rate limiting, and deprecation policies so OXM and OMS interoperate cleanly and third-party integrations are reliable at scale.
* Contribute to engineering productivity - identify and eliminate architectural toil, reduce system complexity where it creates delivery friction, and drive DORA metric improvement through better system design

**Skills And Experience Needed For This Job**

* Deep expertise in Node.js - async processing, high-throughput APIs, event-driven microservices at scale
* Strong working knowledge of Ruby on Rails - MVC patterns, ActiveRecord, background jobs (Sidekiq), API design, and performance optimisation
* Hands-on experience with AWS- EC2, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora/PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElastiCache/Redis, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch
* System design depth - multi-tenant architecture, idempotency, retries, backpressure, failure isolation, and distributed transaction patterns
* Proven track record of designing systems with 99.9%+ uptime and sub-200ms P95 latency
* Strong API design - RESTful, GraphQL, contract testing, versioning, and integration reliability
* Database expertise – MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis; query optimisation, indexing strategies, schema design for high-throughput workload.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools - Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot as productivity multipliers in the SDLC
* Secure SDLC, SAST/DAST, secret scanning, dependency audits, OWASP Top 10, threat modelling

**How You Will Build At Anchanto**

* You will be the technical conscience of OXM and OMS - the person engineering teams come to when they need to make the right call, not just the fast one.
* You will make AI a real part of how we build not a side project by architecting AI-powered features inside our products and enabling engineers to use AI tools as a default, not an exception.
* You will treat scalability, reliability, and cost as first-class design constraints not afterthoughts across every system you touch.
* You will work with Engineering Managers to ensure teams have clear technical direction before they start building, reducing mid-sprint surprises and rework.
* You will hold the bar high every API, every schema, every integration pattern should be something we're proud to still have in production two years from now.

**What Success Looks Like**- Reliability: ≥ 99.9% uptime for owned services.
Performance: < 200ms P95 latency for critical APIs.- AI Delivery: At least one AI-powered capability shipped inside OXM or OMS within 6 months
- Quality: reduction in P1/P2 incidents and MTTR; improving DORA metrics quarter over quarter.
- Platform Standardization: Containerisation and observability standards adopted across both platforms.
- Cost: No unexpected cost blowouts on architectural decisions include cost modelling
**Leadership & Ownership traits you must have**

* Own the technical architecture of OXM and OMS end-to-end from design to production to incident
* Make technical trade-oﬀ calls with clarity and confidence speed vs. correctness, cost vs. scale, build vs. buy
* Drive architectural alignment across engineering teams without formal authority, influence through reasoning, documentation, and trust
* Proactively identify and surface technical risk before it becomes a production problem
* Mentor Tech Leads and Senior Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and engineering standards
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Product to ensure roadmap decisions are technically grounded and deliverable

**Behaviours / Personal Qualities**

* Outcome Ownership: You don't just design systems, you care whether they work in production, at scale, for real customer
* Systems Thinking: You naturally consider failure modes, dependencies, edge cases, and second-order eﬀects before they become someone else's incident.
* Execution Discipline: You follow through. RFCs get written. ADRs get documented. Decisions don't disappear into Slack threads.
* Adaptability: You can work across Node.js and Ruby on Rails stacks, switching context between two distinct platforms without losing depth on either.
* Raising the Bar: You set a standard for what good looks like - in code, in design, in documentation and you hold it consistently.

description:
**About Sciente.**
Sciente is a Singapore-headquartered specialist technology and AI/data consulting firm serving banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), with offices in Malaysia, India, and the USA. Our focus areas are AI-driven GRC, data intelligentisation, business technology consulting and technology talent. We hold ISO 27001, ISO 9001 and PDPTM certifications and partner with Dataiku, Denodo and Neo4j.

**What "vibe coding" means here.**
You describe the outcome in plain language, let AI agents write most of the code, then test, steer and harden the result. The job is judgement, speed and quality control, not typing every line by hand.

**Key responsibilities**

Your time splits between two kinds of build; the mix will shift with the sales pipeline.

**Client PoCs and demos (pre-sales)**

* Turn a client problem statement in FCC, GRC, fraud or data into a working prototype within 3–10 working days.
* Build demo apps and dashboards on synthetic or anonymised BFSI data, never live client data unless contractually cleared.
* Pair with pre-sales consultants to shape the storyline, then make the demo run reliably in front of a client.
* Wire prototypes to Sciente's partner stack (Dataiku, Denodo, Neo4j) and to LLM APIs where the use case needs it.
* Package each PoC with a short README, setup steps and known limitations so others can reuse it.

**Internal tools**

* Build automations and small apps for sales, recruitment, delivery and finance teams (for example, proposal generators, CV screeners, pipeline trackers, report builders).
* Talk to the internal user, ship a first version fast, then iterate on their feedback.
* Maintain a reusable library of components, prompts and templates so each new build starts further ahead.

**Engineering hygiene (non-negotiable)**

* Read and understand every line the AI writes before it ships; you own the code, not the tool.
* Use Git, code review, basic automated tests and secrets management on every project.
* Follow Sciente's ISO 27001 information security controls and data protection obligations.
* Know when a prototype has outgrown vibe coding and hand it to a full engineering team with clear documentation.

**Requirements**

**Must have**

* 3–6 years building software, data apps or analytics products, with real code fundamentals (you can debug without the AI).
* At least 12 months of daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, with a portfolio of things you shipped this way.
* Strong Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; comfortable with REST APIs, SQL and one modern web framework.
* Experience calling LLM APIs and writing structured prompts, including basic retrieval (RAG) patterns.
* Ability to deploy a working app to a cloud environment and keep it running.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to explain a demo to a non-technical client.

**Nice to have**

* BFSI exposure, especially financial crime compliance (FCC), AML, fraud, risk or regulatory reporting.
* Hands-on with Dataiku, Denodo or Neo4j (including Cypher or graph-based RAG).
* UI/UX sense: you can make a demo look credible to a bank's senior management.
* Experience with agentic workflows or multi-agent tooling.
* Security awareness: OWASP basics, secrets handling, data masking.

**Tools**
— we are tool-agnostic and expect the landscape to keep changing. Tell us which AI coding assistants, agents and app builders you use today and why.

title: Security Engineer  —  Application & File Security II
description:
**Role: Security Engineer — Application & File Security**

**Experience: 5+yrs**

**Notice period: Immediate - 15days**

**Work Mode: Remote**

**Background & Authorization**

This is a remote role based in India. The engagement operates on a mid-day to late-night shift to align with the US client team. Working hours are approximately 1:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST during US Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) and 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST during US Eastern Standard Time (EST).

**Role Purpose**

Execute application-layer security remediation for TLS cipher hardening and file upload security controls under the direction of the Security Engineering Lead. Own the precise, tested delivery of these controls — every TLS change validated against the pre-remediation compatibility survey, every file upload control tested against a comprehensive edge-case matrix. Also contributes to the security unit test pilot components.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement load balancer cipher policy changes per Security Engineering Lead design — execute in non-production, validate against compatibility survey, then promote to production through the CI/CD pipeline
* Build and deploy a containerised file upload scanner (ClamAV) — Docker multi-stage image, ECS Fargate or Lambda integration, REST API endpoint, fail-closed error handling, and horizontal auto-scaling
* Implement path traversal protection for archive file uploads (ZipSlip pattern) — archive extraction validation, path normalisation enforcement, rejection of escaping entries
* Implement insecure PDF handling controls — magic byte validation, embedded JavaScript detection, external URL reference blocking, file size limits
* Execute TLS rollback testing — validate rollback from TLS 1.3-only to TLS 1.2 AEAD-only within a maintenance window
* Produce post-remediation cipher scan evidence — compliance report confirming no deprecated cipher suites remain on any endpoint
* Build and execute a comprehensive file upload security test matrix — EICAR test file, oversized ZIP, recursive archive, malformed PDF, MIME type spoofing, double-extension filenames
* Build two pilot security unit test components — OWASP/CWE-mapped JUnit5 test cases for nominated high-risk application components

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years application security engineering; 3+ years hands-on Java/Spring application security on production systems
* TLS/SSL — cipher suite configuration, AWS ALB Security Policy changes, TLS debugging with OpenSSL, HTTPS and HSTS configuration
* ClamAV — daemon configuration, containerised deployment, API integration, performance tuning
* Docker — multi-stage Dockerfile authoring, image hardening, container deployment on AWS ECS or Lambda
* File upload security — MIME type validation, ZipSlip/path traversal prevention, malicious file detection, magic byte validation
* PDF security — malicious PDF structure detection, embedded JavaScript identification
* Java Spring Security — filter chain configuration, security headers, CSRF protection, input validation
* AWS Lambda — function authoring in Python or Java, execution role design, VPC connectivity
* Security test case authoring — edge case coverage with audit-quality evidence documentation

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* OWASP Top 10 training, CEH, or CompTIA Security+
* AWS WAF v2 — custom rule authoring for file upload restrictions
* Fortify SAST finding remediation in Java — CWE-434, CWE-22, CWE-79
* OWASP Dependency-Check for container image vulnerability scanning
* REST API security — rate limiting, content-type enforcement, API Gateway integration

**Tools & Platforms**

ClamAV, Docker, AWS ECS Fargate, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, ALB/NLB (Security Policies), AWS Config, Java Spring Security, OpenSSL, OWASP ZAP, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Confluence

title: Director, Data Scientist & AI Engineering
description:
**Overview**
AI at Cvent: Leading the Future
  
  
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams – Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
The Analytics team is Cvent's internal intelligence engine — the function that powers how the business understands performance, serves commercial teams, and accelerates decision making with data and AI. Within this organization, the AI Engineering & Data Science team designs and deploys production grade AI and ML solutions with a primary mandate across commercial and growth teams - Sales, Marketing, Revenue, Growth teams and others.
  
  
This role is designed for an experienced practitioner ready to step into a leadership position alongside the Head of Data Science & AI. As Manager, you will own delivery, people, and technical standards while remaining a hands-on contributor who can architect and build alongside your team. You are not being hired to manage from a distance — you are being hired to raise the floor and the ceiling of what the team can do.
  
  
The right person for this role brings commercial instinct alongside technical depth. You understand how commercial teams operate, can translate sales and marketing problems into AI solutions, and know how to take work reliably from prototype to production. You are also a developer of people: you build individual capability, hold high standards, and create an environment where engineers grow.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**AI & Data Science Function**

* Partner with the Head of Data Science & AI to run the team — owning delivery execution, team health, stakeholder relationships, and technical direction on a day-to-day basis.
* Serve as the senior technical expert and partner with Architects to set architectural direction, lead design reviews, and make build-vs-buy decisions that shape how solutions are structured and scaled.
* Represent the team in cross-functional forums — with commercial and technical teams translating AI capability nto business language and AI business needs into engineering scope.

**Own End-to-End AI Delivery**

* Lead delivery across the full AI and ML lifecycle — from problem framing and data acquisition through model development, evaluation, deployment, and post-production monitoring.
* Set and enforce engineering standards: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD for ML pipelines, observability, reproducibility, and documentation. Build a culture that ships with both quality and speed.
* Design and implement agentic AI workflows — LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language querying (NLQ), multi-step reasoning pipelines, and human-in-the-loop architectures — across internal commercial and operational use cases.
* Own the team's AI observability posture: output quality monitoring, drift detection, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that keep production systems reliable, explainable, and auditable.

**Drive AI Use Cases**

* Partner closely with cross functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI solutions that improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, and revenue predictability.
* Lead development of Sales and Marketing AI applications — lead scoring, next best action, intent signal modelling, account health prediction, churn early warning, and conversational analytics.
* Translate commercial problems into well-scoped AI initiatives with defined success metrics, baseline comparisons, and measurable business outcomes. Own the narrative when presenting to commercial teams’ leadership.
* Proactively surface new AI use cases with business partners — qualify opportunities by strategic impact and technical feasibility and build the internal case before pursuing them.

**Build and Develop the Team**

* Directly manage a team of data scientists and AI engineers — owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and individual development plans.
* Run structured 1:1s focused on technical growth and career progression. Maintain a skills matrix and design development plans that close capability gaps systematically.
* Foster a high-performance delivery culture: rigorous code review, clear working rhythms, cross-functional stakeholder accountability, and a bias toward shipping working solutions over perfect prototypes.

**Shape AI Platform and Architecture**

* Work with Data Engineering and the Head of Data Science & AI to evolve the team's tooling stack — model registry, feature pipelines, LLM orchestration layer (LangChain, LangSmith, or equivalent), and evaluation infrastructure.
* Contribute to Snowflake as Cvent's enterprise intelligence layer — ensuring ML feature pipelines, semantic layers, and AI workloads are architected for reliability, reuse, and long- term auditability.
* Embed responsible AI practices into delivery: privacy assessments, governance reviews, and alignment with Cvent's AI usage policies throughout the build lifecycle.

**Experience**
**Here's What You Need:**

* 10-13+ years in data science or AI/ML engineering, with a minimum of 2 years in a people management or formal technical lead role with clear delivery ownership.
* Demonstrated track record delivering AI and ML solutions for commercial team — lead scoring, churn prediction, intent modelling, revenue forecasting, NLQ, or comparable commercial applications — in a SaaS or B2B environment.
* Experience working with Salesforce, Marketo, or equivalent GTM platforms as primary data sources. Familiarity with how commercial data flows from CRM to analytics is essential.

**Technical Depth**

* Strong AI engineering fundamentals: LLM application development, RAG and NLQ architectures, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), prompt engineering, and model evaluation at production scale.
* Hands- on ML expertise across the full lifecycle: feature engineering, model training and selection, A/B and champion-challenger testing, deployment, monitoring, and drift management in production.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Jobs) and Snowflake (Cortex, ML functions, feature pipelines) as the core delivery stack.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic search infrastructure — OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or equivalent — for embedding-based retrieval in RAG and NLQ systems.
* Hands-on ability to build internal AI applications and data tools using Streamlit, React, or Node.js — from early prototype to production-ready product.
* Familiarity with AI observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, Datadog, or equivalent) and ML experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases).

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Proven ability to co-lead a team — setting direction, holding standards, developing people, and creating delivery accountability without micromanaging execution.
* Fluency working across Data Engineering, BI, and business teams — translating between technical model requirements and downstream pipeline, reporting, and stakeholder workflow needs.
* Strong commercial communication: the ability to frame AI solutions in terms of business outcomes, present findings, and defend modelling decisions under scrutiny.
* A hunter's instinct: proactively identifying where AI creates leverage, building internal business cases, and expanding the team's scope through demonstrated impact — not just by executing assigned work.

title: Senior Control Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
  
  
As a Senior Controls Engineer, on a typical day within the Loads and Controls team at Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy, you will work on developing, tuning, and validating advanced turbine control strategies using aeroelastic simulations, field data analysis, and automation tools. Your day may involve setting up and running aeroelastic simulation workflows, analyzing turbine response and controller performance, identifying optimization opportunities, and proposing control enhancements to improve energy production and reduce structural loads. You will collaborate closely with global teams across loads, software, and turbine design to solve complex engineering challenges and support validation activities on operational turbines.
  
  
In addition, you will contribute to controller certification activities by preparing technical documentation, supporting compliance analyses, and participating in technical reviews. Through your expertise in controls engineering, simulation-driven development, and data analysis, you will directly support the delivery of innovative and reliable wind turbine solutions that accelerate the transition to sustainable energy.
  
  
How You’ll Make an Impact
  
  
As part of the team, you will contribute to the development, optimization, and validation of advanced wind turbine control systems.
  
  

* Work with aeroelastic simulation tools similar to Flex5, Bladed, or OpenFAST to evaluate and improve turbine control behavior.
* Collaborate with global cross-functional teams across loads, software, mechanical, and validation engineering to solve complex technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain MATLAB/Simulink-based tools and automation workflows for controller tuning, validation, and performance analysis.
* Drive continuous improvements in control methodologies, simulation workflows, and engineering processes while ensuring adherence to engineering quality standards and best practices.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and project updates to stakeholders.
* Contribute actively to technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and innovation within the global engineeringorganization.

What You Bring
  
  
As a part of the Loads and Controls team in Bangalore location, you will execute projects in collaboration with global engineering teams across Denmark, Spain, and other Siemens Gamesa locations.
  
  

* Experience with aeroelastic simulation and control tools such as Flex5, Bladed, or OpenFAST is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with MATLAB/Simulink and a solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles.
* Knowledge of Python, LaTeX, distributed version control systems such as Git or Mercurial, and agile development tools such as Jira will be an added advantage.
* Strong expertise in controller tuning, stability margin analysis, and parameter optimization techniques.
* Compliant, systematic, self-initiative, team player and consistent with excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate in all verticals with multicultural international stakeholders.

Eduction & Experience
  
  
You must have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Control & Automation, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering from a recognized institute.

* Willingness to learn quickly — both the Alpha domain and emerging AI and automation techniques.
* Ownership of assigned deliverables and the discipline to complete them on time.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* A collaborative, delivery-focused attitude in a global team environment.

**These Skills Will Help You Succeed In This Role**

* Understanding investment management or capital markets operations and the trade lifecycle across front, middle and back office.
* Exposure to process mapping and documentation tools (Visio, BPMN, UiPath Task Capture or equivalent).
* Awareness of automation platforms such as UiPath and of AI/GenAI concepts including RAG and knowledge structuring.
* Good analytical skills with working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to organize work, manage multiple tasks and deliver to agreed timelines.
* Flexibility to work across APAC, UK or US time zones as required.

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems.

title: The Analytics Research Institute
description:
Postdoctoral Researcher — Trustworthy and Responsible AI
  
  
The Analytics Research Institute (ARI) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to develop and evaluate ethical, trustworthy, and safe uses of artificial intelligence in research analytics. ARI conducts research in the science of science and supports organizations in understanding research investments and their outcomes. This position will contribute to real-world projects, including work supporting the National Institutes of Health.
  
  
The researcher will investigate, and make recommendations on how to implement, how AI can support analysis of research grants, publications, and related information while maintaining rigor, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. The role combines hands-on development with research into reliability, bias, explainability, reproducibility, and the risks of relying on AI-generated outputs.
  
  
Working with ARI’s multidisciplinary team, the successful candidate will receive mentorship while developing increasing independence. Candidates should be self-starters and bring relevant research experience and an interest in applying it to practical problems. They are not expected to arrive with expertise in every method or data source.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Design evaluations that compare AI approaches with established analytical methods and human review, using realistic tasks and clearly defined performance criteria.
* Investigate errors, bias, uncertainty, unsupported claims, and other failure modes; assess their consequences for intended users and applications.
* Develop and test safeguards, including source verification, human review, and criteria for when an output should be withheld or escalated.
* Create reproducible workflows and document data, methods, model configurations, supporting evidence, and limitations.
* Contribute to practical guidance for responsible AI use, including privacy, appropriate data access, transparency, and accountability.
* Communicate findings through technical documentation, demonstrations, presentations, and scholarly publications.

**Required Qualifications**

* A Ph.D. completed by the start date in computer science, data science, statistics, informatics, computational social science, or a related discipline.
* Research experience applying AI or machine learning, with practical experience in at least one relevant area, such as natural language processing, language models, embeddings, or retrieval.
* Proficiency in Python and experience developing documented, reproducible research code.
* A foundation in experimental design, model evaluation, and quantitative error analysis.
* Demonstrated interest in ethical, trustworthy, and safe AI, and an ability to critically assess model outputs and technical claims.
* Clear communication, collaborative working skills, and willingness to learn unfamiliar methods and subject matter.

Helpful, but not required
  
  
Experience with responsible-AI research, explainability, uncertainty estimation, human–AI interaction, knowledge graphs, or scientific and government data. Candidates may develop these skills through focused learning and project work.
  
  
Research and development opportunities
  
  
The position offers opportunities to shape reusable evaluation methods, publish findings, and gain experience translating AI research into tools and analyses that support real decisions.

title: Programmatic/oRTB Manager - Supply-Side
description:
**About Jungle Technology**

We're the world's leading No-SDK, No-Code Branding Ad Network, built for mobile publishers who want more revenue without touching their codebase.

Today, we power monetization across 20,000+ apps, including 7 of the top 10 gaming publishers and 1 in 4 casual games worldwide.

**The Role**

We need someone to own our CTV and in-app supply path end to end. Integration, pricing, packaging, optimization, monitoring, scale. All of it.

This is not a ticket queue. You'll be expected to understand the auction underneath, chase down why something isn't performing, form a view, test it, and move the number. If you like knowing why a bid didn't win and not just that it didn't, read on.

**What You'll Own**

* Integrations - VAST/VPAID and oRTB across CTV and in-app. Publisher and app onboarding through to live traffic.
* Supply optimization - Floor strategy, traffic shaping, QPS efficiency, supply path and curation calls. The funnel is yours: requests → bid rate → bid density → win rate → render rate → fill → eCPM.
* Debugging and testing - Bid requests and responses, VAST errors, wrapper chains, render failures, latency. Find the cause, run the experiment, ship the fix.
* Inventory quality - oRTB supply signals, schain, consent strings, IFA and CTV identifiers. ads.txt, app-ads.txt, sellers.json, blocklists, IVT.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years in programmatic. Hands-on, not oversight
* Deep oRTB knowledge. You read bid requests and responses and troubleshoot without help
* CTV and/or in-app supply experience
* Major SSPs, plus video platforms like PLL, Adtelligent, and Aniview
* VAST/VPAID fluency: tags, wrappers, error codes, latency, render diagnostics
* Auction mechanics: floors, bidding dynamics, deal prioritization, supply optimization
* You build your own analysis in Sheets or Excel instead of waiting for someone to send it
* Comfortable working across publishers, SSPs, DSPs, product, and engineering

**What Matters Most**

You're genuinely into this. The ecosystem changes every quarter, and nobody is going to hand you a curriculum. The right person already keeps up with new standards, platforms, auction dynamics, and supply-quality requirements because they find it interesting. You enjoy getting into the detail and working out how things actually function.

**What You Get**

Ownership of a revenue-critical function, early. Direct influence over how our supply is built, not just how it's run. A lean team where a good idea ships in days. Access to the biggest names in the ecosystem. Conferences, industry events, and team offsites. Impact you can point at.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

We get a high volume of applications that have nothing to do with this role. To save your time and ours, please do not apply if:

* Your background is performance marketing, paid media buying, Google Ads, Meta/Facebook Ads, or SEO/SEM. This is a supply-side programmatic infrastructure role, not a campaign management role
* You do not have hands-on CTV or in-app programmatic supply experience
* You have less than 3 years of relevant programmatic experience

We review every application, but profiles outside this scope will not be shortlisted.
